hedefler.aciklama: Track your period goals with measurable key results (KRs): check-ins, comparison with expected progress, an alignment tree and period close.
hedefler.aciklamaYonetici: The agency's own objectives and key results. If you link an objective to a client account and share it, the client sees it as a read-only card in their panel.
hedefler.okurNot: You have read-only access: you can view objectives and reports but cannot change them.

donem.ilkAciklama: Objectives belong to a period (quarter, year or custom date range). Create a period to get started.
donem.adIpucu: If left empty, it is generated from the period type (e.g. 2026 Q4).
donem.etkinYap: Make this the active period (the panel opens with it)
donem.silOnay: Delete this period? (A period with objectives cannot be deleted.)

liste.bos: No objectives in this period yet.

hedef.baslikIpucu: An inspiring, qualitative objective (e.g. “Deliver the best customer experience in our industry”).
hedef.ustIpucu: Alignment: which bigger objective does this one serve?
hedef.musteriIpucu: If the objective belongs to work for a client, select their account.
hedef.paylasIpucu: Shown in the client panel as a read-only card: only the objective and KR progress (check-in notes are not shared).
hedef.silOnay: Delete the objective with its key results and check-in history? (It can be restored from the trash.)

kr.baslikIpucu: A measurable outcome (e.g. “Grow monthly new customers to 20”).
kr.elleIpucu: You update the value with check-ins.
kr.otomatikIpucu: The value is calculated automatically from the selected source for the objective's period.
kr.kaynakYok: Automatic sources need one of the bookkeeping, inventory and POS, appointments or courses modules to be enabled.
kr.evetHayirIpucu: When it's done, mark “Yes” with a check-in.
kr.agirlikIpucu: This KR's share of the objective's progress (1–10).
kr.silOnay: Delete this key result and its check-in history?

kaynak.crm_aday: CRM: leads received in the period

checkin.otomatikNot: This KR's value is calculated automatically; a check-in only adds confidence and a note.

agac.aciklama: Objectives are arranged under their parent objectives. Parents from other periods appear faded with a period label.

kapanis.aciklama: When closing the period, give every key result a score between 0 and 1 (suggestion: its progress). Unfinished KRs can be copied to the next period you choose; their history stays linked.
kapanis.tasiHepsi: Carry unfinished KRs over to the next period
kapanis.donemYok: Create the next period first to carry KRs over.
kapanis.onay: Close this period? Objectives and KRs cannot be changed in a closed period.
kapanis.tamam: Period closed: {{hedef}} objectives and {{kr}} key results carried over.

ai.aciklama: Get SMART key result suggestions for your objective.
ai.not: Suggestions are not added until you pick and save one; review the values.

odak.kaydedildi: A {{dk}}-minute focus session was added to the KR as a note.
odak.molaBitti: Break over; ready for a new session.

hata.genel: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
hata.cok_hizli: Too many requests; please wait a moment.
hata.yetki_yok: You are not allowed to do this.
hata.hesap_izni_yok: Your team permissions do not allow this.
hata.aralik_disinda: The value must be between {{en_az}} and {{en_cok}}.
hata.tarih_ileride: A check-in cannot be dated in the future.
hata.bitis_once: The end cannot be before the start.
hata.donem_cok_uzun: A period can be at most 3 years.
hata.donem_dolu: A period that contains objectives cannot be deleted.
hata.donem_kapali: The period is closed; no changes allowed.
hata.donem_siniri: The period limit has been reached.
hata.hedef_siniri: This period can have at most {{en_cok}} objectives.
hata.kr_siniri: An objective can have at most {{en_cok}} key results.
hata.yon_tutarsiz: The target does not match the direction (increase: target ≥ start; decrease: target ≤ start).
hata.hizalama_dongusu: This parent would create a loop (an objective cannot be aligned to its own child).
hata.paylasim_kosulu: To share, select a client account and set visibility to “Team”.
hata.yalniz_ajans: Sharing with clients is only available for agency objectives.
hata.sahip_ekipte_yok: The owner is not on the team.
hata.kaynak_gecersiz: This source cannot be used here.
hata.kaynak_kapali: This source's module is disabled or you are not allowed to see its data.
hata.kaynak_yok: This KR has no automatic source.
hata.hesaplanamadi: The source value could not be calculated.
hata.puan_gecersiz: The score must be between 0 and 1.
hata.hedef_donem_gecersiz: The target period must be open and different.
hata.ai_butce: Today's AI usage limit has been reached.
hata.ai_bicim: The AI response could not be read; try again.
hata.ai_bos: The AI returned an empty response.
